{{Quote|Nithorn feathers are very telling, and her body language suggested that she is very familiar with whoever Ilkemisti is.|[[Chelli Lona Aphra]], to [[Luke Skywalker]] on [[Shoo]] and [[Ilkemisti]]|<ref name="Chaos Agent 2">[[Doctor Aphra – Chaos Agent 2|''Doctor Aphra – Chaos Agent'' 2]]</ref>}}
'''Nithorns''' were an [[Bird|avian]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]] with [[leather]]y [[Color|orange]]-and-green skin, black [[eye]]s and beaked faces. Members of the species were both present at [[the Lodge]] on [[Vandor]] and the ''[[First Light]]''.<ref name="The Official Guide" /> One was also seen shopping on [[Ghorman]] in [[3 BBY]].<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere">{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}}</ref>
